name: Registrar-gated DataTable structured selection frame

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

primaryTarget: headed WASM/WebGPU DataTable fixture at DPR 1 and DPR 2
hypothesisMarkdown:
## Registrar-gated DataTable structured selection frame

Start `TableSelectionModel` frame collection only when the current traversal exposes a SelectionArea registrar. Outside an area, clear stale structured selection and preserve the table child unchanged.
measurementPlanMarkdown:
### Measurement plan

Run the dedicated DataTable headed WASM/WebGPU fixture at DPR 1 and DPR 2 and inspect its screenshot. Compare input-to-published-frame samples before and after if fixture output is stable; reject any behavior or visual regression.
expectedOutcomeMarkdown:
### Expected outcome

DataTables outside SelectionArea no longer call structured selection begin-frame collection, while an enclosing area retains registration and current behavior.

measurements.target: headed WASM/WebGPU DataTable fixture; 35 repetitions per DPR with five warmups discarded

reportMarkdown:
## Registrar-gated DataTable structured selection frame

Rejected and reverted. The DataTable fixture passed 70/70 headed WASM/WebGPU runs and its screenshot remained correct, but the candidate did not meet the p95 gate against the retained baseline: DPR 1 was 118.19 ms vs 113.772 ms and DPR 2 was 121.60 ms vs 113.164 ms. The source was returned to its checkpoint before this result was recorded.
